# S2 eject parity: the semantics program prints identical output under
# logos build and under logos eject plus plain go build.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

logos run .
cp stdout $WORK/logos-stdout.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go

cd out
go run .
cp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/logos-stdout.txt
cd ..

cmp $WORK/logos-stdout.txt $WORK/eject-stdout.txt
cmp $WORK/logos-stdout.txt want-stdout.txt

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/defereject

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func failAt(n int) error {
	if n%2 == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("fail %d", n)
}

func loop(n int) (err error) {
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		defer failAt(i)?
	}
	return nil
}

type box struct{ v int }

func (b *box) close() error {
	b.v++
	return nil
}

func method(b *box) (err error) {
	defer b.close()?
	return nil
}

func join2() (err error) {
	defer failAt(1)?
	defer failAt(3)?
	return nil
}
type optNote struct{ last int }

func (o *optNote) Note(v int) error {
	o.last = v
	return nil
}

func mkOptNote() *optNote? {
	return &optNote{}
}

func spanOpt(m *optNote?) (err error) {
	defer m?.Note(2 + 3)?
	return nil
}
var cleanup func(int) error

func install() int {
	cleanup = func(n int) error {
		fmt.Println("installed", n)
		return nil
	}
	return 1
}

// The deferred callee resolves after the argument call in both twins:
// install replaces cleanup before the deferred call runs.
func reassign() (err error) {
	defer cleanup(install())?
	return nil
}

type Stamp struct{ A, B uint64 }

var epoch uint64 = 1

func advance() int {
	epoch = 2
	return 0
}

func save(v any, n int) error {
	fmt.Println("saved", v, n)
	return nil
}

// A struct passed to an interface parameter snapshots before a later
// argument call mutates the fields it reads, in both twins.
func reassignStruct() (err error) {
	defer save(Stamp{epoch, epoch}, advance())?
	return nil
}

func savePair(v int, n int) error {
	fmt.Println("pair", v, n)
	return nil
}

func take(ch chan int) int {
	select {
	case v, ok := <-ch:
		if !ok {
			return -1
		}
		return v
	default:
		return -1
	}
}

// A receive keeps its position before a later argument call in both
// twins: take drains the closed channel only when the deferred receive
// has not already taken its value.
func recvBeforeCall() (err error) {
	ch := make(chan int, 1)
	ch <- 5
	close(ch)
//logos:allow(correctness::unbounded_channel_op)
	defer savePair(<-ch, take(ch))?
	return nil
}

func gAny[T any](v T, n int) error {
	fmt.Println("generic", v, n)
	return nil
}

// A literal passed to an inferred generic parameter is not interface
// boxed: its fields are read after the later argument call in both twins.
func genericArg() (err error) {
	defer gAny(Stamp{epoch, epoch}, advance())?
	return nil
}

 var seen any = "unset"

func probe() error {
	seen = recover()
	return nil
}

func recoverInF() (err error) {
	defer probe()?
	panic("boom")
}

func recoverProbe() {
	defer func() {
		fmt.Println("recover in f:", seen, "outer:", recover())
	}()
	if err := recoverInF(); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("unexpected", err)
	}
}

func main() {
	if err := loop(3); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("loop err:", err)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("loop ok")
	}
	b := &box{}
	if err := method(b); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("method err:", err)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("method ok", b.v)
	}
	if err := join2(); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("join err:", err)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("join ok")
	}
	mn := mkOptNote()
	if err := spanOpt(mn); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("span err:", err)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("span", (mn ?? &optNote{}).last)
	}
	if err := reassign(); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("reassign err:", err)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("reassign ok")
	}
	if err := reassignStruct(); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("reassign-struct err:", err)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("reassign-struct ok")
	}
	if err := recvBeforeCall(); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("recv err:", err)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("recv ok")
	}
	if err := genericArg(); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("generic err:", err)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("generic ok")
	}
	recoverProbe()
}

-- m/want-stdout.txt --
loop err: fail 1
method ok 1
join err: fail 3
fail 1
span 5
installed 1
reassign ok
saved {1 1} 0
reassign-struct ok
pair 5 -1
recv ok
generic {2 2} 0
generic ok
recover in f: <nil> outer: boom
